renderedFields.description:
To reproduce, using the UI (fcrepo-webapp):

1. create a resource.
2. create a new version of this resource
3. click on the newly created version link.
4. from the version page, click "fcr:versions" link in the breadcrumb.
5. You should see the following stacktrace:
